TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Āmana ar-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi min rrabbihi wa-l-muʾminūna kullun āmana bi-llāhi wa malʾāʾikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin mmin rrusulihi wa qālū samiʿnā wa aṭaʿnā ghufrānaka rabbanā wa ilayka l-maṣīru lā yukallifu llāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā lahā mā ka-sabat wa ʿalayhā mā iktasabat rabbanā lā tuʾākhidhnā in nnasīnā aw akhṭaʾnā rabbanā walā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿalā alladhīna min qablinā rabbanā walā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bihi wa iʿfu ʿannā wa ighfir lanā wa irḥamnā anta mawlānā fānṣurnā ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīn
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: 285 The Messenger believes in what was revealed to him from his Lord, as do the believers. Each believes in Allah, His angels, His scriptures, and His messengers. “We make no distinction between any of His messengers.” They say, “We hear and obey. Our Lord, we seek Your forgiveness, and to You is the final return.” 286 Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It receives the good it earns and bears the evil it commits. “Our Lord, do not hold us to account if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place upon us a burden like the one You placed upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bi-ismika rabbī wa ḍaʿtu janbī, wabika arfaʿuhu, faʾin amsakta nafsī frḥamhā, waʾin arsaltahā fa iḥfaẓhā, bimā taḥfaẓu bihi ʿibādaka aṣ-ṣāliḥīn
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innaka khalaqta nafsī wa anta tawaffāhā, laka mamātuhā wa maḥyhā, in aḥyaytahā fa iḥfaẓhā, waʾin amattahā fa ighfir lahā. allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿāfiyah
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take it’s life, to You belongs it’s life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take it’s life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant me good health.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma qinī ʿadhābaka yawma tabʿathu ʿibādak
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bi-ismika llāhumma amūtu wa aḥyā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In Your name O Allah, I live and die.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subḥāna llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to Allah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: All praise is for Allah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhu akbar
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah is the Greatest.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma rabba as-samawāti as-sabʿi warabba l-ʾarḍi, warabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, rabbanā warabba kulli shayʾin, fa-l-qa l-ḥabbi wa an-nawā, wa munzila at-tawrāti wa-l-ʾinjīli, wa-l-furqāni, aʿūdhu bika min sharri kulli shayʾin anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatih. allāhumma anta l-ʾawwalu fa laysa qablaka shayʾun, wa anta l-ʾākhiru fa laysa baʿdaka shayʾun, wa anta aẓ-ẓāhiru fa laysa fawqaka shayʾun, wa anta l-bāṭinu fa laysa dūnaka shayʾun, iqḍi ʿannā ad-dayna wa aghninā mina l-faqr
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock i.e. You have total mastery over. O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You. You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You. Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aṭʿamanā wa saqānā, wa ka-fānā, wa āwānā, fakam mimman lā kāfiya lahu walā muʾwiy
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ʿālima l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati fāṭira as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi, rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkahu, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wamin sharri ash-shayṭni wa shirkihi, waʾan aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sūʾan, aw ajurrahu ilā muslim
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma aslamtu nafsī ilayka, wa fawwaḍtu amrī ilayka, wa wajjahtu wajhī ilayka, wa aljaʾtu ẓahrī ilayka, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayka, lā maljaʾa walā manjā minka illā ilayka, āmantu bi-kitābika alladhī anzalta, wa bi-nabiyyika alladhī arsalt
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You. Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.

TITLE: Invocation to say if you stir in the night

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-wāḥidu l-qahhru, rabbu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazyzu l-ghaffār
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar. Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all between them, The Exalted in Might, The Oft-Forgiving.

TITLE: What to say if you are afraid to go to sleep or feel lonely and depressed

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min ghaḍabihi wa ʿiqābihi, washarri ʿibādihi, wamin hamazāti ash-shayṭīni waʾan yaḥḍurūn
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.

TITLE: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، [وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ]، تَبارَكْتَ رَبَّنا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ihdinī fīman hadayta, wa ʿāfinī fīman ʿāfayta, wa tawallanī fīman tawallayta, wa bārik lī fīmā aʿṭayta, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayta; fa innaka taqḍī walā yuqḍā ʿalayka, innahu lā yadhillu man wa-l-yta, walā yaʿizzu man ʿādayta tabrakta rabban wa taʿālayt
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to and bless for me that which You have bestowed. Protect me from the evil You have decreed for verily You decree and none can decree over You. For surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom You take as an enemy is never honoured and mighty. O our Lord, Blessed and Exalted are You.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bi-riḍāka min sakhaṭika, wa bi-muʿāfātika min ʿuqūbatika, wa aʿūdhu bika minka, lā uḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayka, anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِينَ مُلْحَقٌ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلاَ نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفرُكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma iyyāka nʿbudu, walaka nuṣallī wa nasjudu, wa ilayka nasʿā wa naḥfidu, narjū raḥmataka, wa nakhshā ʿadhābaka, inna ʿadhābaka bi-l-kāfirīna mulḥaq. allāhumma innā nastaʿynuka, wa nastaghfiruka, wa nuthnī ʿalayka l-khayra, walā nakfuruka, wa nuʾminu bika, wa nakhḍaʿu laka, wa nakhlaʿu man yakfruk
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You. We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You.

TITLE: What to say immediately following the Witr prayer

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subḥāna l-maliki l-quddūs
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to the King, the Most Holy.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: رَبِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Rabbi l-malāʾikati wa ar-rūḥ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

TITLE: Invocations in times of worry and grief

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innī ʿabduka, ibnu ʿabdika, ibnu amatika, nāṣiyatī bi-yadika, māḍin fīa ḥukmuka, ʿadlun fīa qaḍāʾuka, asʾaluka bikulli ismin huwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahu fī kitābika, aw ʿallamtahu aḥadan min khalqika, awi istaʾtharta bihi fī ʿilmi l-ghaybi ʿindaka, an tajʿala l-qurʾāna rabīʿa qalbī, wa nūra ṣadrī, wa jalāʾa ḥuznī, wa dhahāba hammī
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand i.e. You have total mastery over, Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa-l-ḥazani, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-l-bukhli wa-l-jubni, wa ḍalaʿi ad-dayni wa ghalabati ar-rijāl
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.

TITLE: Invocations for anguish

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-ʿaẓīmu l-ḥalīmu, lā ilāha illā llāhu rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, lā ilāha illā llāhu rabbu as-samawāti warabbu l-ʾarḍi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīm
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū, falā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿaynin, wa aṣliḥ lī shaʾnī kullahu, lā ilāha illā ant
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina aẓ-ẓlimīn
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhu llāhu rabbī lā ushriku bihi shayʾā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.

TITLE: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقاتِلُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma anta ʿaḍudī, wa anta naṣīrī, bika aḥūlu wabika aṣūlu, wabika uqtil
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Ḥasbun allāhu wa niʿma l-wakīl
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee He is.

TITLE: Invocations against the oppression of rulers

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma rbba as-samawāti as-sabʿi, warabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, kun lī jāran min fulāni bni fulānin, wa aḥzābihi min khalāʾiqika, an yafruṭa ʿalayya aḥadun minhum aw yaṭghā, ʿazza jāruka, wajalla thanāʾuka, walā ilāha illā ant
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu aʿazzu min khalqihi jamīʿan, allāhu aʿazzu mimmā akhāfu wa aḥdharu, aʿūdhu bi-llāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, al-mumsiki as-samawāti as-sabʿi an yaqaʿna ʿalā l-ʾarḍi illā bi-idhnihi, min sharri ʿabdika fulānin, wa junūdihi wa atbāʿihi wa ashyāʿihi, min al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi, allāhumma kun lī jāran min sharrihim, jalla thanāʾuka waʿazza jāruka, wa tabāraka ismuka, walā ilāha ghayruk
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You.

TITLE: Invocation against an enemy

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma munzila l-kitābi, sarīʿa l-ḥisābi, ihzimi l-ʾaḥzāba, allāhumma hzimhum wa zalzilhum
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.

TITLE: What to say if you fear people may harm you

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ikfinīhim bimā shiʾt
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.

TITLE: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Āmantu bi-llāhi wa rusulih
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: ﴿هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Huwa l-ʾwwalu wa-l-ʾākhiru wa aẓ-ẓhiru wa-l-bṭinu wahuwa bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has full knowledge of everything.

TITLE: Invocations for the settling of a debt

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ikfinī bi-ḥalālika ʿan ḥarāmika, wa aghninī bi-faḍliki ʿamman siwāk
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa-l-ḥazani, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-l-bukhli wa-l-jubni, wa ḍalaʿi ad-dayni wa ghalabati ar-rijāl
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.

TITLE: Invocation against the distractions of Satan during the prayer and recitation of the Quran

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.

TITLE: Invocation for when you find something becoming difficult for you

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā jaʿaltahu sahlan, wa anta tajʿalu l-ḥazna idhā shiʾta sahlā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.

TITLE: Invocation for when something you dislike happens, or for when you fail to achieve what you attempt to do

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Qadaru llāhu wamā shāʾa faʿal
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.

TITLE: Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bāraka llāhu laka fī l-mawhūbi laka, wa shakarta l-wāhiba, wa balagha ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrah
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah bless the child granted to you, enable you to thank the Giver, allow the child to reach maturity, and bless you with the child’s dutifulness.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bāraka llāhu laka wa bāraka ʿalayka, wa jazāka llāhu khayran, wa razaqaka llāhu mithlahu, wa ajzala thawābak
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah bless you and shower His blessings upon you, reward you with goodness, grant you a similar blessing, and make your reward abundant.

TITLE: How to seek Allah's protection for children

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Uʿīdhukumā bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmatin, wamin kulli ʿaynin lāmmah
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I commend you two to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.

TITLE: Invocations for visiting the sick

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā bʾsa ṭahūrun in shāʾa llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Never mind, may it the sickness be a purification, if Allah wills.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفيَكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Asʾalu llāha l-ʿaẓyma rabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi an yashfyak
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’. 7times he the sick person will be cured.

TITLE: Invocations of the terminally ill

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa alḥiqnī bi-ar-rafīqi l-ʾaʿlā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: ‘O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāhu inna lilmawti sakarāt
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāhu wa-llāhu akbaru, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lā ilāha illā llāhu lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu, lā ilāha illā llāhu walā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.

TITLE: What to encourage the dying person to say

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

TITLE: Invocation for when tragedy strikes

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Innā li-llāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūna, allāhumma jurnī fī muṣībatī, wa akhlif lī khayrā minhā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return. O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

TITLE: Invocation for closing the eyes of the dead

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِـ{{deceasedName}} وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ighfir li-{{deceasedName}} wa irfaʿ darajatahu fī l-mahdiyyīna, wa ikhlufhu fī ʿaqibihi fī l-ghābirīna, wa ighfir lanā walahu yā rabba l-ʿālamīna, wa ifsaḥ lahu fī qabrihi, wa nawwir lahu fīh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, forgive {{deceasedName}} and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.

TITLE: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجَاً خَيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ]
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ighfir lahu wa irḥamhu, wa ʿāfihi, wa iʿfu ʿanhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassiʿ mudkhalahu, wa ighsilhu bi-l-māʾi wa ath-thalji wa-l-baradi, wa naqqihi mina l-khaṭāyā kamā naqqayta ath-thawba l-ʾabyaḍa mina ad-danasi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjā khayran min zawjihi, wa adkhilhu l-jannata, wa aʿidhhu min ʿadhābi l-qabri wa ʿadhābi an-nār
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ighfir li-ḥayyinā wa mayyitinā, wa shāhidinā wa ghāʾibinā, wa ṣaghīrinā wa ka-byrinā, wa dhakarinā wa unthānā. allāhumma man aḥyaytahu minnā fa aḥyihi ʿalā l-ʾislāmi, waman tawaffaytahu minnā fa tawaffahu ʿalā l-ʾīmāni, allāhumma lā taḥrimnā ajrahu, walā tuḍillanā baʿdah
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma inna fulāna bna fulānin fī dhimmatika, wa ḥabli jiwārika, faqihi min fitnati l-qabri, wa ʿadhābi an-nāri, wa anta ahlu l-wafāʾi wa-l-ḥaqqi, fa ighfir lahu wa irḥamhu innaka anta l-ghafūru ar-raḥīm
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ʿabduka wa ibnu amatika iḥtāja ilā raḥmatika, wa anta ghaniyyun ʿan ʿadhābihi, in kāna muḥsinan fazid fī ḥasanātihi, waʾin kāna musīʾan fa tajāwaz ʿanh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.

TITLE: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma aʿidhhu min ʿadhābi l-qabr
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, protect him from the punishment of the grave.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلاَفِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ijʿalhu fa raṭan wa dhukhran li-wa ad-dayhi, wa shafīʿan mujāban, allāhumma thaqqil bihi mawāzīnahumā, wa aʿẓim bihi ujwrahumā, wa alḥiqhu bi-ṣāliḥi l-muʾminīna, wa ijʿalhu fī ka-fa-l-ti ibrāhīma, waqihi bi-raḥmatika ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, allāhumma ighfir li-aslāfinā, wa afrāṭinā, waman sabaqanā bi-l-ʾīmān
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, make him a forerunner and a treasure for his parents, and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted. O Allah, make their scales heavy through him and increase their rewards through him. Join him with the righteous believers, place him in the care of Ibrahim, and protect him by Your mercy from the punishment of Hell. Grant him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive our predecessors, our children who died before us, and those who preceded us in faith.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً، وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ijʿalhu lanā fa raṭan, wa salafan, wa ajrā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward

TITLE: Invocation for the bereaved

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Inna li-llāhi mā akhadha, walahu mā aʿṭā, wakullu shayʾin ʿindahu bi-ajalin musammā... faltaṣbir waltaḥtasib
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Indeed, to Allah belongs what He has taken, and to Him belongs what He has given. Everything with Him has an appointed term. So let her be patient and seek Allah’s reward.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Aʿẓama llāhu ajraka, wa aḥsana ʿazāʾaka, wa ghafara li-mayyitik
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah increase your reward, comfort you in your bereavement, and forgive your deceased.

TITLE: Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismi llāhi wa ʿalā sunnati rasūli llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.

TITLE: Invocation to be recited after burying the dead

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ighfir lahu, allāhumma thabbith
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him

TITLE: Invocation for visiting the graves

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتأْخِرِينَ] أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ahla ad-diyāri, mina l-muʾminīna wa-l-muslimīna, wa innā in shāʾa llāhu bikum lāḥiqūna, wa yarḥamu llāhu l-mustaqdimīna minnā wa-l-mustʾkhirīna asʾalu llāha lanā wa lakumu l-ʿāfiyah
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you. [And may Allah have mercy on those of us who have gone before and those who come later.] I ask Allah for well-being for us and you.

TITLE: Invocations for when the wind blows

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa khayra mā ursilat bihi, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri mā fīhā, washarri mā ursilat bih
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.

TITLE: Invocation for when it thunders

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subḥāna alladhī yusabbiḥu ar-raʿdu bi-ḥamdihi wa-l-malāʾiktu min khīfatih
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: How perfect He is, The One Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.

TITLE: Some invocations for rain

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma isqinā ghaythan mughīthan marīʾan marīʿan, nāfiʿan ghayra ḍārrin, ʿājilan ghayra ājil
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma aghithnā, allāhumma aghithnā, allāhumma aghithnā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma isqi ʿibādaka, wa bahāʾimaka, wa inshur raḥmataka, wa aḥyī baladaka l-mayyit
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.

TITLE: Invocation for when it rains

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfiʿā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.

TITLE: Supplication after it rains

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Muṭirnā bi-faḍli llāhi wa raḥmatih
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

TITLE: Invocation for the withholding of the rain

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ḥawālaynā walā ʿalaynā, allāhumma ʿalā l-ʾākāmi wa aẓ-ẓirābi, wa buṭūni l-ʾawdiyati, wa manābiti ash-shajar
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, let it fall on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.

TITLE: Invocation for sighting the new moon

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhu akbaru, allāhumma ahillahu ʿalaynā bi-l-ʾamni wa-l-ʾīmāni, wa as-salāmati wa-l-ʾislāmi, wa at-tawfīqi limā tuḥibbu rabbanā wa tarḍā, rabbunā wa rabbuka llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.

TITLE: Invocations for breaking the fast

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Dhahaba aẓ-ẓamaʾu wa ibtallati l-ʿurūqu, wa thabata l-ʾajru in shāʾa llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-raḥmatika allatī wa siʿat kulla shayʾin an taghfira lī
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.

TITLE: Invocations before eating

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismi llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismi llāhi fī awwalihi wa ākhirih
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa aṭʿimnā khayran minh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, bless it for us and provide us with food better than it.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa zidnā minh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.

TITLE: Invocations after eating

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aṭʿamanī hādhā, wa razaqanīhi, min ghayri ḥawlin minnī walā quwwah
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi ḥamdan ka-thīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīhi, ghayra makfiyyin walā muwaddaʿin, walā mustaghnayan ʿanhu rabbanā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord. There are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. He is The One Who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. The One Who is longed for, along with that which is with Him and The One Who is needed, He is our Lord.

TITLE: A dinner guest's invocation for his host

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُم، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma bārik lahum fīmā razaqtahum, wa ighfir lahum wa irḥamhum
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.

TITLE: Invocation for someone who gives you drink or offers it to you

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma aṭʿim man aṭʿamanī, wa isqi man saqānī
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.

TITLE: Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Afṭara ʿindakumu aṣ-ṣāʾimūna, wa akala ṭaʿāmakumu l-ʾabrāru, wa ṣallat ʿalaykumu l-malāʾikah
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.

TITLE: What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Innī ṣāʾimun, innī ṣāʾim
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I am fasting, I am fasting.

TITLE: Invocation for when you see the first dates of the season

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma bārik lanā fī thamarinā, wa bārik lanā fī madīnatinā, wa bārik lanā fī ṣāʿinā, wa bārik lanā fī muddinā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our saʿ for us and bless our mudd for us.

TITLE: Invocation for sneezing

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: All praise is for Allah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Yarḥamuka llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah have mercy on you.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Yahdīkumu llāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.

TITLE: What to say to the disbeliever if he sneezes and praises Allah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Yahdīkumu llāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

TITLE: Invocation for the groom

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bāraka llāhu laka, wa bāraka ʿalayka, wa jamaʿa baynakumā fī khayr
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah bless for you your spouse and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.

TITLE: The groom’s supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā jabaltahā ʿalayhi, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri mā jabaltahā ʿalayh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.

TITLE: Invocation to be recited before intercourse

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismi llāhi, allāhumma jannibnā ash-shayṭāna, wa jannibi ash-shayṭāna mā razaqtanā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.

TITLE: Invocation for anger

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.

TITLE: What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī ʿāfānī mimmā ibtalāka bihi, wa faḍḍalanī ʿalā ka-thīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.

TITLE: What to say while sitting in an assembly

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Rabbi ighfir lī, watub ʿalayya, innaka anta at-tawwābu l-ghafūr
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me to accept my repentance. Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.

TITLE: The Expiation of Assembly - Kaffaratul-Majlis

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subḥānaka llāhumma wa bi-ḥamdika, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.

TITLE: Invocation for someone who says: May Allah forgive you

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَلَكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Walak
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: and you.

TITLE: Invocation for someone who does good to you

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Jazāka llāhu khayrā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah reward you with goodness.

TITLE: Invocation for someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Aḥabbaka alladhī aḥbabtanī lah
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.

TITLE: Invocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bāraka llāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.

TITLE: Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Braka llāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālika, innamā jazāʾu as-salafi l-ḥamdu wa-l-ʾadāʾ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.

TITLE: Invocation for fear of Shirk

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa anā aʿlamu, wa astaghfiruka limā lā aʿlam
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.

TITLE: Invocation for someone who tells you: May Allah bless you

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa fīka bāraka llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: and may Allah bless them.

TITLE: Invocation against evil portent

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَيْرَ إِلاَّ طَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma lā ṭayra illā ṭayruka, walā khayra illā khayruka, walā ilāha ghayruk
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.

TITLE: Invocation for riding in a vehicle or on an animal

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾، ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي؛ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ))
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismi llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna, wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, al-ḥamdu li-llāhi, al-ḥamdu li-llāhi, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥānaka llāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī fa ighfir lī; fa innahu lā yaghfiru adh-dhunūba illā ant
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this transport at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You.

TITLE: Invocation for traveling

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna llāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhā l-birra wa at-taqwā, wamina l-ʿamali mā tarḍā, allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa iṭwi ʿannā buʿdahu, allāhumma anta aṣ-ṣāḥibu fī as-safari, wa-l-khalīfatu fī l-ʾahli, allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi as-safari, wa kābati l-manẓari, wa sūʾi l-munqalabi fī l-māli wa-l-ʾahl
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, though we could never have managed it ourselves. Surely, to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who watches over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from distressing sights, and from returning to find harm in our wealth or family.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Āyibūna, tāʾibūna, ʿābidūna, li-rabbinā ḥāmidūn
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: We return, repent, worship, and praise our Lord.

TITLE: Invocation for entering a town or city

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّياطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma rabba as-samawāti as-sabʿi wamā aẓlalna, warabba l-ʾaraḍīna as-sabʿi wamā aqlalna, warabba ash-shayṭīni wamā aḍlalna, warabba ar-riyāḥi wamā dharayna, asʾaluka khayra hādhihi l-qaryati, wa khayra ahlihā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri ahlihā, washarri mā fīhā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.

TITLE: Invocation for entering a market

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاِ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, yuḥyī wa yumītu, wahuwa ḥayyun lʾi yamūtu, bi-yadihi l-khayru, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.

TITLE: Invocation for when your vehicle or mount begins to fail

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismi llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah.

TITLE: The traveler's invocation for the one he leaves behind

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Astawdiʿukumu llāha alladhī lā taḍīʿu wa dāʾiʿuh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.

TITLE: The resident's invocations for the traveler

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Astawdiʿu llāha dīnaka, wa amānataka, wa khawātīma ʿamalik
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ ما كُنْتَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Zawwadaka llāhu at-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa yassara laka l-khayra ḥaythu m kunt
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.

TITLE: The traveler's invocation at dawn

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذاً بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Sammaʿa sāmiʿun bi-ḥamdi llāhi, wa ḥusni balāʾihi ʿalaynā, rabbanā ṣḥibnā, wa afḍil ʿalaynā, ʿāʾidhan bi-llāhi mina an-nār
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours and bounties upon us. Our Lord, protect us, show favour on us and deliver us from every evil. I take refuge in Allah from the fire.

TITLE: Invocation for a layover (stopping along the way) on the journey

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil that He has created.

TITLE: What to say upon returning from a Journey

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, āyibūna, tāʾibūna, ʿābidūna, li-rabbin ḥāmidūna, ṣadaqa llāhu waʿdahu, wa naṣara ʿabdahu, wa hazama l-ʾaḥzba waḥdah
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.

TITLE: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī bi-niʿmatihi tatimmu aṣ-ṣāliḥāt
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: All praise is for Allah, by whose grace good things are brought to completion.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi ʿalā kulli ḥāl
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.

TITLE: How to reply to a disbeliever if he says Salam to you

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَعَلَيْكُمْ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa ʿalaykum
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And upon you.

TITLE: Invocation for someone you have spoken ill to

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma fa ayyumā muʾminin sababtuhu fa ijʿal dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawma l-qiyāmah
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, let that be cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.

TITLE: How a Muslim should praise another Muslim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Aḥsibu fulānan wa-llāhu ḥasībuhu, walā uzakkī ʿalā llāhi aḥadā
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I consider so-and-so [to be…], and Allah is his Reckoner. I do not declare anyone pure before Allah.

TITLE: What a Muslim should say when he is praised

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ، [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ]
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma lā tuʾākhidhnī bimā yaqūlūna, wa ighfir lī mā lā yaʿlamūna, wa ijʿalnī khayran mimmā yaẓẓunnūn
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].

TITLE: The pilgrim's announcement of his arrival for Hajj or Umrah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Labbayka llāhumma labbayka, labbayka lā sharīka laka labbayka, inna l-ḥamda, wa an-niʿmata, laka wa-l-mulka, lā sharīka lak
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Here I am O Allah, in response to Your call, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.

TITLE: Invocation to be recited between the Yemenite Corner and the Black Stone

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: ﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ﴾
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Rabbanā ātinā fī ad-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fī l-ʾākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāba an-nār
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Our Lord, give us what is good in this world and what is good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

TITLE: Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ﴾ أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Inna aṣ-ṣafā wa-l-marwata min shaʿāʾiri llāhi abdaʾu bimā badaʾa llāhu bih
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāhu, allāhu akbar
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah. Allah is the Greatest.

TITLE: Invocation to be recited on the Day of Arafat

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.

TITLE: What to say when surprised or startled

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ!
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subḥāna llāh!
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: How perfect Allah is.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ!
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhu akbar!
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah is the greatest.

TITLE: What to say when you feel a pain in your body

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismi llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi wa qudratihi min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear.

TITLE: What to say when you feel frightened

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ!
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāh!
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

TITLE: What to say when slaughtering or sacrificing an animal

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismi llāhi wa-llāhu akbaru llāhumma minka walaka llāhumma taqabbal minnī
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, it is from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.

TITLE: What to say to foil the devil's plots

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلاَ فَاجِرٌ: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلاَّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Aʿūdhu bkalimāti llāhi at-tāmmāti allatī lā yujāwizuhunna barrun walā fājirun: min sharri mā khalaqa, wa baraʾa wa dharaʾa, wamin sharri mā yanzilu mina as-samāʾi, wamin sharri mā yaʿruju fyhā, wamin sharri mā dharaʾa fī l-ʾarḍi, wamin sharri mā yakhruju minhā, wamin sharri fitani l-layli wa an-nahāri, wamin sharri kulli ṭāriqin illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bi-khayrin yā raḥmān
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. I take refuge from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. I take refuge from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.

TITLE: Repentance and seeking forgiveness

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Astaghfiru llāha l-ʿaẓyma alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayywumu wa atūbu ilayh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I seek Allah’s forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.

TITLE: The excellence of remembering Allah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdihi, subḥna llāhi l-ʿaẓīm
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subḥāna llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, walā ilāha illā llāhu, wa-llāhu akbar
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subḥāna llāhi l-ʿaẓīmi wa bi-ḥamdih
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: How perfect Allah is. The Supreme, and I praise Him.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no might nor power except with Allah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subḥāna llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, walā ilāha illā llāhu, wa-llāhu akbar
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, allāhu akbaru ka-bi-yran, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi ka-thīran, subḥāna llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. Allah is the Greatest—supremely great. Abundant praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa ihdinī, wa irzuqnī
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, and provide for me.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allāhumma ighfiri lī, wa irḥamnī, wa ihdinī, wa ʿāfinī wa irzuqnī
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: All praise is for Allah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lā ilāha illā llāh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سبحان الله والحمد لله، ولا إله إلا الله،والله أكبر،و لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Sbḥn allāh wlḥmd li-llāh wl ilāh l allāh wllh kbr w l ḥwl wl qwh l bllh
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: 'Glorified is Allah', and'The praise is for Allah', and'but There is none worthy of worship Allah', and'Allah is the Most Great', and'There is no power and no might except by Allah'
